summary.intent: Continue the Callisto v1 hardening queue autonomously; in this window, fix npm space-separated and hyphen version ranges so a dependent with `>=1.0.0 <2.0.0` stops the run with E319 instead of being silently skipped.
summary.outcome: Added `npm_comparators` normalization in callisto-model version parsing, with unit and end-to-end cascade tests and a changeset. After fixing a comma-form regression, full CI passed (631 unit tests, 92.9% coverage) and the commit/push/PR step was run for `fix/npm-space-ranges`.

repo: npm ranges with spaces (`>=1.0.0 <2.0.0`) previously went to the `semver` crate unmodified, which requires commas, so parsing failed and the spec was treated as opaque and silently skipped in cascades.
Spec VER-CAS-06 already says ranges the bump leaves behind stop the run (E319); the code now matches it.
Hyphen ranges map exactly to a comparator pair only when both ends are full semver; partial ones (`1.0 - 2`) stay unsupported.
The comma-form range `>=1.0.0, <2.0.0` is covered by an existing test in callisto-manifests (`round_trip_comma_compound_range_returns_none`), so any range rewrite must leave comma clauses intact.
Cascade scenario tests in callisto-cli/tests/cascade_scenarios_tests.rs are the model for end-to-end tests of version-stop behavior.
`just ci` has to run with sandbox disabled, and a stray `crates/.claude` dir has to be removed before it runs.

code.finding: `npm_comparators(clause)` splits on whitespace, merges operator-only tokens with the next token, converts full-semver hyphen ranges to `>=low, <=high`, and returns None for dangling operators or other standalone `-`. It is used in the npm branch of `VersionReq::parse`. Tokens must drop trailing commas, or the clause must be returned untouched if it already contains commas, otherwise the rewrite doubles the comma.
`round_trip_comma_compound_range_returns_none` builds its spec via `make_npm_spec`, which unwraps `VersionReq::parse`, so it caught the comma-doubling regression.
Added `a_space_separated_npm_range_the_bump_leaves_behind_stops_the_run_before_any_write` (peer `>=0.1.0 <1.0.0`, lib major bump gives E319, manifest unchanged).

workflow: `git switch main` lands on a stale local main; branch from `origin/main` instead and rebuild before reproducing.
`version` stages its result, so a plain `git diff` looks empty; use `git diff --staged`.
Run a repro script visibly before concluding a fix did not apply.
Use unique PR body filenames to avoid stale bodies being reused.
Run the full CI after refactoring a parser; an existing test in a different crate caught a regression the new unit tests missed.

friction: The first `package.json` repro ran against a stale build because of the stale local main.
The empty-diff result was misleading because the output was staged.
The comma-form regression only surfaced in full CI, in a different crate from the change.
The commit/push/PR command was issued twice and its result is not shown in the transcript.
open_items: Confirm PR for `fix/npm-space-ranges` was created, and check merge state of #353-#357 and #349, keeping branches current without force-pushing.
